mapper.sql: FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.product_id,SUM(i.stock_qty) batch_qty,SUM(CASE WHEN i.manages_expiry=0 OR i.expiry_date >= #{today} THEN i.stock_qty ELSE 0 END) unexpired_qty,SUM(CASE WHEN i.manages_expiry=1 AND i.expiry_date < #{today} THEN i.stock_qty ELSE 0 END) expired_qty,SUM(CASE WHEN i.manages_expiry=1 AND i.stock_qty>0 AND DATEDIFF(i.expiry_date,#{today}) BETWEEN 0 AND p2.near_expiry_days THEN i.stock_qty ELSE 0 END) near_qty,MIN(o.stocked_at) first_stocked_at,MAX(o.stocked_at) last_stocked_at,SUM(CASE WHEN i.manages_expiry=1 AND i.stock_qty>0 AND DATEDIFF(i.expiry_date,#{today}) BETWEEN 0 AND p2.near_expiry_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) near_batch_count,SUM(CASE WHEN i.manages_expiry=1 AND i.stock_qty>0 AND i.expiry_date<#{today} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) expired_batch_count FROM purchase_item i JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id=i.purchase_id JOIN product p2 ON p2.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='IN_STOCK' AND i.batch_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.product_id) b ON b.product_id=p.id
CASE WHEN p.enabled=1 AND p.can_sell=1 THEN COALESCE(b.unexpired_qty,0) ELSE 0 END

where.if: AND (CONVERT(p.code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR CONVERT(p.barcode USING utf8mb4)=#{query.keyword})

choose.when: AND p.enabled=1 AND p.can_sell=1 AND () <= p.stock_lower_limit
choose.otherwise: AND NOT(p.enabled=1 AND p.can_sell=1 AND () <= p.stock_lower_limit)

mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) id,p.code,p.barcode,p.name,CAST(p.category_id AS CHAR) category_id,c.name category_name,p.specification,p.unit,p.enabled,p.can_sell,p.stock_qty book_qty,COALESCE(b.batch_qty,0) batch_qty, saleable_qty,COALESCE(b.expired_qty,0) expired_qty,p.stock_lower_limit,p.frozen_stocktake_id IS NOT NULL frozen,b.last_stocked_at ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product WHERE id=#{id})
mapper.sql: WHERE i.product_id=#{id} AND i.batch_no IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('IN_STOCK','REVERSED')AND i.stock_qty > 0AND (CONVERT(i.batch_no USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR i.supplier_batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR CONVERT(o.order_no USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) id,i.batch_no,i.supplier_batch_no,CAST(o.id AS CHAR) purchase_id,o.order_no purchase_no,(#{canReadPurchase} AND (#{scope.admin} OR o.operator_id=#{scope.userId})) source_readable,o.status source_status,i.production_date,i.expiry_date,CASE WHEN i.manages_expiry=1 THEN DATEDIFF(i.expiry_date,#{today}) ELSE NULL END remaining_days,i.stock_qty,i.unit_cost,(o.status='IN_STOCK' AND i.stock_qty>0 AND p.enabled=1 AND p.can_sell=1 AND (i.manages_expiry=0 OR i.expiry_date>=#{today})) saleable,p.frozen_stocktake_id IS NOT NULL frozen,p.enabled,p.can_sell,o.stocked_at FROM purchase_item i JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id=i.purchase_id JOIN product p ON p.id=i.product_id ORDER BY o.stocked_at DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_item i JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id=i.purchase_id
mapper.sql: FROM stock_movement m JOIN product p ON p.id=m.product_id JOIN purchase_item i ON i.id=m.batch_item_id JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id=i.purchase_id

where.if: AND (CONVERT(m.business_no USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR CONVERT(i.batch_no USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR CONVERT(p.code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT CAST(m.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(p.id AS CHAR) product_id,p.code product_code,p.name product_name,p.unit,CAST(i.id AS CHAR) batch_id,i.batch_no,m.event_type,m.business_no,m.delta_qty,m.batch_before,m.batch_after,m.product_before,m.product_after,m.actor_name,m.reason,m.occurred_at,CASE WHEN m.event_type IN ('PURCHASE_IN','PURCHASE_REVERSE') THEN CAST(o.id AS CHAR) ELSE NULL END purchase_id,(#{canReadPurchase} AND m.event_type IN ('PURCHASE_IN','PURCHASE_REVERSE') AND (#{scope.admin} OR o.operator_id=#{scope.userId})) source_readable ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
